welcome.title: Welcome to MAGRABi,
welcome.invited: {company} has invited you to register as a supplier for {category}.
welcome.needIntro: Based on your country ({country}), please have these ready:
welcome.noInvoice: A signed quotation or contract is enough. We never ask for an invoice before the purchase order.
welcome.time: About 10 minutes. You can save and come back any time.
welcome.principle: Our AI reads your documents. Our rules check them. Official registries confirm them. A person at MAGRABi decides.
welcome.how1b: Company, tax, bank, contacts. Save any time.
welcome.how2b: We read each one instantly and tell you if something needs fixing.
welcome.how3b: You get your vendor code by email.

review.confirm: I confirm these details are correct and the documents are genuine.
